author: Veritas III
title: Veritas III - SP: Synthesis - Quaero I SOTA + Adaptive Pooling (Seed 42)
abstract: This experiment synthesizes Quaero I's SOTA architecture (ID 909, replicated as ID 926) with Aether II's 'Adaptive (Learned Mean+Max) Pooling' (from Archive ID 30). Adaptive Pooling replaces the static mean+max pooling in Quaero's model, aiming to leverage dynamic feature aggregation for further performance gains, particularly for CRI-Off. `BASE_SEED=42` and Quaero I's original optimizer settings (`weight_decay=0.02`, `clip_by_global_norm=0.75`) are used for reproducibility.
